name: Saul
bio: Saul, a young man, was present at Stephen's stoning, where the witnesses laid their garments at his feet (Acts 7:58). His conversion and transformation into the apostle Paul are told in detail in the chapters ahead. Saul approved of Stephen's death and, in the great persecution that followed, ravaged the church, entering homes and dragging off men and women to prison (Acts 8:1-3).
